name: Assistro Order Notifications
author: heratassistro

sections.description:
Assistro Order Notifications allows you to automatically send notifications to your customers when their order status changes. It integrates with the Assistro API using JWT authentication.

Key Features:
* Automatic Notifications: Send messages for Pending, Processing, On Hold, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded, and Failed order statuses.
* Customizable Templates: defined custom message templates for each status using tags like {name}, {order_id}, {total}, and {status}.
* Enable/Disable Toggle: Selectively enable or disable notifications for specific order statuses.
* WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly hooks into WooCommerce order status changes.
* Logging: Errors are logged to the WooCommerce logs for easy debugging.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/assistro-order-notifications directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Assistro Order Notifications’ settings page in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your JWT Token in the ‘JWT Settings’ tab.
  5. Configure your message templates and enable notifications in the ‘WooCommerce Events’ tab.1. Upload the entire assistro-order-notifications folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  6. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).

You will find Assistro Order Notifications menu in your WordPress admin screen.
sections.faq:
Do I need an external service?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work with the Assistro API. You will need a valid JWT token from the provider.

Can I customize the messages?

Yes, you can fully customize the message text for each order status and use dynamic placeholders.
